title: NormalizedEvent
description: Canonical event published to Kafka topic `normalized-events`, keyed by `event_id` (docs/CONTRACTS.md §1.2). All eight keys are always present; `component_id` is serialised as an explicit JSON null when absent on the raw event.

timestamp.description: Raw `timestamp` converted to a UTC instant.

ingested_at.description: UTC instant at which ingestion-service normalised the event.

utcInstant.description: UTC instant in ISO-8601 form with a `Z` suffix (java.time.Instant#toString); fractional seconds optional, up to nanoseconds.
